claims.fact: One hidden U(1) connection and one charged complex scalar S. S is a hidden-sector SM singlet coupled through H-dagger-H S-star-S. The example excludes additional charged hidden matter and preserves charge conjugation. X is the gauge connection, not a separate matter row.

claims.locator: PDF p.1 Section II and p.3 Eq. (14); Atlas R_SM template
claims.fact: Retain source-declared SM, three ordinary chiral families and one Higgs, all hidden neutral. Scalar S is SM neutral.

claims.locator: PDF p.3 Eq. (14); complete-inventory normalization convention
claims.fact: Source does not assign a numeric charge to S. With only one nonzero hidden charge, choose its positive generator orientation and primitive local-algebra unit q_S=1; this is a convention-derived coordinate, not a printed charge or a global-group claim. SM hypercharge is q=6Y.
